name: Market intraday momentum: first half hour (incl. overnight) predicts the last half hour
why: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou (2018): informed traders who act at the open and late-informed / rebalancing traders who act near the close trade the same way, so the return to 10:00 predicts 15:30-16:00. Pre-registered 2026-10-23 (research/preregistered/2026-10-23_starnet_open_items.md X2).
